answer: An agent economy can require each identity to lock collateral before it may trade, then select bonded agents at random to audit one another’s claims and transactions. Honest reports preserve reputation and return the bond; coordinated deception triggers slashing and exclusion from future work. A Sybil attacker must therefore buy and lock substantial capital for every fake identity, while surviving audits and losing funds when the identities amplify a false ripple through the market. Saffron and timber agents face the same rule.
